This article includes the legitimate scientific concept of genes that are expressed only when carried by the female parent . It is not to be confused with the generally discredited theory of maternal impression . A maternal effect is a situation where the phenotype of an organism is determined not only by the environment it experiences and its genotype , but also by the environment and genotype of its mother . In genetics , maternal effects occur when an organism shows the phenotype expected from the genotype of the mother , irrespective of its own genotype , often due to the mother supplying mRNA or proteins to the egg . Maternal effects can also be caused by the maternal environment independent of genotype , sometimes controlling the size , sex , or behaviour of the offspring . These adaptive maternal effects lead to phenotypes of offspring that increase their fitness . Further , it introduces the concept of phenotypic plasticity , an important evolutionary concept .

Maternal sensitivity is a mother 's ability to perceive and infer the meaning behind her infant 's behavioural signals , and to respond to them promptly and appropriately . Maternal sensitivity affects child development at all stages through life , from infancy , all the way to adulthood . Also , maternal sensitivity has been found to affect the person psychologically even as an adult .
